airmail.definition:
n. letters and packages that are transported by aircraft
n. a system of conveying mail by aircraft
v. send or transport by airmail

airmailed.definition: v send or transport by airmail
airmailed.translation: v. 航空邮寄( airmail的过去式和过去分词 ); <谑>投; 掷; 抛

airmailer.translation:
n. 航空邮政[亦作 air mail]；航空邮件
vt. 航空邮寄；[戏谑语]投，掷，抛：
adj. 航空邮政的；航空邮件的

airmailing.definition: v send or transport by airmail
airmailing.translation: v. 航空邮寄( airmail的现在分词 ); <谑>投; 掷; 抛

airmails.definition:
n letters and packages that are transported by aircraft
n a system of conveying mail by aircraft
v send or transport by airmail
airmails.translation: vt. 航空邮寄（airmail的第三人称单数形式）

airman.definition: n someone who operates an aircraft
airman.translation: n. 飞行员, 空军士兵

airmanship.definition: n the art of operating aircraft
airmanship.translation: n. 飞行技术, 导航技术

airmen.definition: n someone who operates an aircraft
airmen.translation: n. 航空从业员；飞行员（airman的复数）

airmiss.translation: abbr. aircraft-in-flight collision barely missed 几乎不能错过的飞机飞行冲突

airmisses.translation: (airmiss 的复数) abbr. aircraft-in-flight collision barely missed 几乎不能错过的飞机飞行冲突
